When this skill is equipped, restores device HP over time after the device is deployed. On activation, the device loses 1 HP every 0.5 seconds, and grants the Operator in front 1 SP and a Barrier equal to 2% of Nasti's Max HP. Immediately activates the devices on the field. Stops attacking and gains a Barrier equal to 4% of her Max HP every 0.5 seconds (Barrier cannot exceed 32% of Max HP) Gains 1 Device when skill ends

stages.effectText: Increases the max number of Support Devices that can be held by +1 and reduces their Deployment Cost [ note 1 ]
Can carry 3 <Support Devices> (deploy up to 2), with different effects depending on Skill; first device has reduced Deployment Cost [ note 2 ]

Can carry 3 <Support Devices> (deploy up to 2), with different effects depending on Skill; first device has reduced Deployment Cost; [ note 2 ] each device can combine effects with other devices in its attack range
